entries.en: to remember, to recollect; to think of with longing (of one beloved)
entries.notes: R 栏官话音写（aucande a caua dolore, amando）晦涩且截断、难以对读，释义依 L（pensar）/H（憶）/M 三栏。

entries.en: to grieve, to become sad; sorrow
entries.notes: M 栏声调区污損难辨（T99）且音读 huan 与「悲」不甚合，R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（entristecerse+悲）。

entries.en: to think; to imagine
entries.notes: R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H/M（imaginar+想+sio）三栏互证。

entries.zh: 吟咏、吟诵；沉吟（低吟思忖）
entries.en: to chant, to recite (verse); to hum and muse
entries.notes: R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H/M（吟：吟咏、沉吟思忖）。

entries.en: to think, to ponder; to imagine
entries.notes: M 栏声调区污損难辨（T99），R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（想）。

entries.zh: 思念、挂念；思虑（为照看养育操心）
entries.en: to think of, to miss; to be concerned for (someone's care and upbringing)
entries.notes: R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H/M 三栏（cuidar y criar 语境下「思」的挂念义）。

entries.en: to think and imagine; thoughts
entries.notes: R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H/M 三栏互证。

entries.zh: 检点、检省（思量当为之事并自我检束）
entries.en: to examine oneself, to consider what is to be done; to keep oneself in check
entries.notes: 西语尾词 monuince 无法确解，R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（思量当为之事+检）。

entries.zh: 请托、央请；思量当为之事
entries.en: to request, to engage (someone); to consider what is to be done
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:倩]且 M 音 chay 与「請/倩」音不甚合，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 反省、省察（思省当为之事）
entries.en: to examine oneself, to reflect; to consider what must be done
entries.notes: R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H/M（反省义）三栏互证。

entries.en: to think to oneself; to ponder inwardly
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:揆]且 M 栏声调区污損（T99），释义依西语 entre sí（心中自想）。

entries.en: to think to oneself; inner thoughts
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:衷]，R 栏[空]，释义依 L/M（simg 近「心」音）推断。

entries.zh: 思慕、爱慕（心中念着所爱之人）
entries.en: to yearn for, to admire; to think of the one beloved
entries.notes: M 栏第二成分 movilibon 非汉语音写、疑为污损误读，释义依 L/H（思所爱+慕）。

entries.en: to consider, to deliberate; to worry
entries.notes: 西语 uazio 难确解（或为 vacío 闲空之意），R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（虑）。

entries.zh: 暗心、心怀歹念（心中暗想恶事）
entries.en: to think evil in one's heart; wicked thoughts
entries.notes: R 栏[空]，L/H/M（algo malo+暗心+àm-sim）三栏互证一致。

entries.zh: 暗行、暗中做恶事；心存歹意
entries.en: to do evil secretly; secret wicked conduct
entries.notes: M 栏声调区污損难辨（T99），R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（暗行）。

entries.en: to plot secretly, to scheme in one's heart
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:里]且 M 栏声调区污損（T99），释义依西语 traçar entre sí（心中谋画）。

entries.en: to think secretly to oneself; to scheme in thought
entries.notes: M 栏声调区污損难辨（T99），R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（暗想）。

entries.en: to think to oneself; one's own musings
entries.notes: M 栏声调区污損难辨（T99），R 栏[空]，释义依 L/H（自想）。

entries.zh: 衷曲、内心隐情（心底曲折心思）
entries.en: one's innermost feelings; hidden workings of the heart
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:衷]且 M 栏声调区污損（T99），依「entre sí+衷曲」推断。

entries.en: to think with care, to ponder deeply
entries.notes: 汉字两字均标注[疑]（剥[疑:剖]、骨[疑:冒]）且 M 音 pag-uir 未确解，释义主要依西语 pensar con cuidado。

entries.zh: 空想、虚想（心中空虚无益之想）
entries.en: vain thoughts, idle fantasies; to dream idly
entries.notes: M 栏声调区污損难辨（T99）、R 栏[空]；空想义依 L（pensamientos vanos）/H 可定。
